title: Sleep Now, Predict Later
body: The Data $$100$$ team explores the relationship between hours of sleep, whether a student has a major affiliated with CDSS, and GPA. The team fits the following multiple regression model to the collected data: $$\hat{y}=\theta_0+\theta_{1}\text{hours\_sleep}+\theta_{2}\text{is\_cdss}.$$ The fitted parameters are $$\hat{\theta}_{0}$$ $$=$$ $$1.2$$, $$\hat{\theta}_{1}$$ $$=$$ $$0.23$$, and $$\hat{\theta}_{2}$$ $$=$$ 0.5.\n##figure1.gif
